title: Bias Beyond Borders: Political Ideology Evaluation and Steering in Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Administering a culturally adapted Political Compass Test (PCT) via zero-shot prompting with a four-level Likert scale, computing continuous stance values, and projecting them onto orthogonal economic (left-right) and social (libertarian-authoritarian) axes.

Translating semantically equivalent political statements into over 30 languages and comparing the models' ideological stances across these languages to isolate cross-lingual variations and language-conditioned ideological shifts.
